cd /tmp/obench-cell-rdv_4ot8/bench_opencode_model-extraction-relu-logits_rfp7s_lo && python steal.py | head -2 && python -c "
import numpy as np, forward
A=forward.A1; S=np.load('stolen_A1.npy')
An=A/np.linalg.norm(A,axis=1,keepdims=True)
C=S@An.T
print('stolen rows',len(S))

print('true rows matched:',sorted(set(np.abs(C).argmax(1))))
"
